title: Banff and Jasper Trip Planner Printable, Canadian Rockies Itinerary, Lake Louise Moraine Lake Guide, Best Day Hikes, Alberta Travel PDF
description:
Planning a first trip to Banff and Jasper? This 30-page printable guide puts the whole Canadian Rockies trip on paper: when to go, what to book and in what order, how to reach Lake Louise and Moraine Lake now that private cars can't drive to Moraine Lake, and how to spend 3, 5 or 7 days.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- The parks at a glance: Banff, Lake Louise and Jasper, where to sleep, which airport to fly into, and drive times in miles and km
- When to go, season by season: thawed lakes, wildflowers, golden larches, shuttle seasons and winter driving rules
- Park passes in CAD (daily admission or the Discovery Pass), and crossing from the US: documents, driving, money and bear spray
- What to book and when: rooms, campgrounds, the Lake Louise and Moraine Lake shuttles and Roam transit
- Getting to Lake Louise and Moraine Lake without your car
- The Icefields Parkway: stops in order, fuel and no-signal stretches
- Wildlife (bears, elk, safe distances, bear spray, the group rule on some trails) and mountain weather
- Sample 3-day, 5-day and 7-day plans, each with a make-it-work page
- 12 day hikes, from Johnston Canyon and Lake Agnes Tea House to Larch Valley, Parker Ridge and Valley of the Five Lakes, with distance in mi and km and climb in ft and m, from Parks Canada
- Rainy-day ideas, packing list, trip budget (CAD), day-by-day planner, bookings log and notes

WHAT YOU GET
- US Letter and A4 versions
- Mobile edition, sized for reading on your phone
- Color and printer-friendly (low ink) versions
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
Checked against Parks Canada in November 2026. Shuttle dates, fees, closures and trail rules change every year, so check parks.canada.ca for your dates before you book. No maps or GPS files. Not affiliated with Parks Canada. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable hiking guides in our Etsy shop.
